title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: conversation orchestration with natural language playbooks
summary: The briefing's rollout dates, administrator path, prerequisites and publish-time billing statements are supported by Microsoft's records and documentation. The governance checklist names several controls that are missing from the controls table; this is a minor completeness issue, not a reason to hold publication.
